en.headline: Golden Week day two sees 954,000 crossings by 9pm
en.dek: The Immigration Department said more than 954,000 people crossed Hong Kong's control points by 9pm on Friday, the second day of the mainland holiday.
body: The Immigration Department said more than 954,000 people passed through Hong Kong's control points by 9pm on Friday, the second day of the mainland National Day Golden Week.

Inbound crossings were nearly 478,000. Mainland visitors accounted for more than 227,000 of those arrivals, and the department said the largest number came in through West Kowloon Station on the high-speed rail.
Outbound crossings were more than 477,000. Hong Kong residents made up nearly 280,000 of the departures, with the largest number leaving through Lo Wu.

zh.headline: 黃金周次日晚上九時 出入境逾95萬人次
zh.dek: 入境處表示，周五晚上九時前全港管制站錄得超過95萬4千人次出入境，內地旅客最多經高鐵西九龍站入境。
body: 入境處表示，內地國慶黃金周第二天，截至周五晚上九時，全港各管制站共錄得超過95萬4千人次出入境。
入境近47萬8千人次，其中內地旅客超過22萬7千人次。入境處指，最多內地旅客經高鐵西九龍站入境。
出境超過47萬7千人次，本港居民佔近28萬人次，最多經羅湖口岸離境。
